name: Lugia Shadow

name: Celebi
method: Solve all eight Ruins of Alph puzzles: four slider puzzles and four wall puzzles. Enter a passage in B1F to find the GS Ball, take it to Kurt in Azalea Town, then visit the Ilex Forest shrine. • ESCAPE: Use an Escape Rope from the Bag. • WATER: Use a Water Stone from the Bag. • LIGHT: Use Flash from the party menu. • HOOH: Bring Ho-Oh with you.

name: Darkrai
method: After obtaining Cresselia, show it to your rival in their house. Go to Cherrygrove City and enter the inn with Cresselia in your party. • Accept the Moon Key. • Go to your room at the top of the stairs, examine the bed, and choose not to sleep or resist sleeping. • Go outside, return to the lobby, and inspect the papers on the wall. • Inspect the Luxray trophy in the long hallway. • Inspect the old telephone on the front desk and call the number formed by the stack of papers. • Examine the piano to find a small key, then use it on the nearby safe. • Walk upstairs to find Darkrai.
